# Netsidian 0.3.0

This release improves canvas navigation, document editing and file workflows.

- Maps, Graph and task boards share zoom and minimap controls. Task boards support a Hand tool, Space-drag and dragging empty space without moving tasks.
- Map cards have larger Markdown text, seamless inline editing and resizing, selectable/reconnectable connectors, edge navigation, and a double-click preview that preserves zoom.
- Boards and Maps lists group items by folder, with search, folder filters and document activity dates. The file explorer can create documents, folders, memos, boards and maps, with quick-open controls for board/map files.
- Memos has a compact composer, live formatting and tags, a resizable calendar sidebar, and fewer distractions. Normal wiki-link edits no longer trigger protected-link warnings.
- Updated Netsidian branding uses the supplied N14 artwork with application accent colors.
- Reading mode is the default, with configurable editing and preview interactions. Internal map metadata stays out of rendered document views.
- MCP documentation reviews agent knowledge and project workflows, context budgets and company-wide access. The proposed domain tools are a design backlog, not additional server APIs in this release.

Existing Markdown files, board/map metadata, revision checks and permissions remain in use.

## Downloads and deployment

Desktop archives cover Linux x64, Windows x64, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon.
Linux requires GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0; Windows requires WebView2 Runtime. macOS
bundles are ad-hoc signed and are not Apple notarized. Each archive includes
installation instructions and the license. Verify downloads using `SHA256SUMS`.

```sh
docker run -d --name netsidian -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -v netsidian-state:/netsidian-state ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.3.0
```

The Helm package uses chart version and application image tag `0.3.0`.
`docker-image.txt` records the immutable multi-platform image digest.
